summary: Full redesign verification of Sri Balanjaneya Swamy Temple (Rampura) site. Backend regression: 8/8 pytest tests pass against the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (health, event registration valid/422-missing/422-invalid-phone, registrations list + event_id filter, contact valid/422-invalid-email). Frontend: all 8 routes load with their data-testid='page-*' (/, /rampura, /temple, /hayagreeva, /mantra, /gallery, /events, /visit). Home hero shows 'Sri Balanjaneya Swamy · Rampura' headline with 'JAI SRI RAM' eyebrow and both CTAs (hero-temple-cta, hero-events-cta). All home sections render: home-stotra, home-announcements, home-before-after (NEW diptych verified visually — before/after Anjaneya idol side-by-side with 'BEFORE · AFTER' caption), home-puranic, home-two-idols, home-cardinal, home-blessings, home-shrine-banner, home-visit-teaser. Temple page renders temple-before-after (NEW), temple-two-idols, temple-architecture, temple-blessings (now present, previously missing), arch-rekha-deula, arch-hoysala-pillars, arch-hayagreeva-scripts. Stotra ribbon renamed correctly to data-testid='stotra-ribbon'. Gallery shows 7 tiles (0..6) and lightbox opens on click. RSVP form on /events submits → rsvp-success. Contact form on /visit submits → contact-success. Mobile menu opens and lists all 8 bilingual nav links. Content audit: zero occurrences of 'Doc 1', 'Doc 2', 'Document 1/2', 'older booklet', 'verify before publishing', 'source notes', 'booklet' across all 8 rendered routes. READABILITY: programmatic contrast sampling — 40/40 sampled elements pass WCAG AA, with footer text (Pages list, address, hours, copyright) measured at 16.24:1 ratio (cream rgb(242,234,217) on anthracite rgb(17,12,9)). Iteration-2 contrast complaints (faded hero subtitle + barely-readable footer) are fully resolved.
action_items: (Cosmetic, optional) Right edge of the 'AFTER' photo in the home-before-after diptych shows a faint watermark/text fragment 'ara D ...' clipped against the frame. If this is an embedded photo credit it can stay; if accidental, crop or remove.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor React hydration warning on /events: a dev-instrumentation <span data-ve-dynamic='true'> is injected as a child of <option>, which the HTML spec disallows and React flags as a hydration mismatch. Not a user-visible breakage, but worth quieting before production — likely originates from the build-time x-source instrumentation wrapping dynamic text inside option elements.
Backend server.py: root message at @api_router.get('/') still reads 'Sri Balanjaneya Swamy Temple, Rampura — API' (good); FastAPI title is 'Rampura Balanjaneya Temple API' (good). Nothing else stale.
CORS allow_origins still defaults to '*' with allow_credentials=True — browsers reject this combo. For production, set CORS_ORIGINS explicitly in backend/.env.
POST /api/events/register and /api/contact return 200 (instead of 201) on resource creation — convention nit, non-blocking.
Backend persists created_at as ISO string and reparses on read — works but prefer native BSON datetime for consistency.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — every requested testid, page, flow, content-audit and contrast check passed

seed_data_creation: TEST_-prefixed event registrations and contact rows were created by pytest and Playwright flows. Safe to leave or purge — no impact on production seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_api.py (8 tests, all green). REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://cauvery-heritage.preview.emergentagent.com. New verified testids this iteration: stotra-ribbon (renamed from stotra-strip), home-before-after, home-announcements, temple-before-after. Site is now fully readable — anthracite #110C09 background with cream #F2EAD9 text consistently across hero/sections/footer. Reveal component (used heavily on Home) sets initial opacity:0 and animates to 1 on IntersectionObserver — when measuring contrast programmatically, scroll element into view first or you'll get false opacity:0 readings on off-screen content. All RSVP/contact flows persist to MongoDB.
rca of the issue: Iteration 2 reported (1) faded hero subtitle / footer text below AA, (2) Temple page missing blessings band. Both root-caused and fixed by E1: (1) Color overhaul to a strict 2-canvas system (anthracite #0E0B08 + ivory #F3EAD8) with hard-coded text colors instead of low-opacity utility classes — verified 16.24:1 footer contrast and 0 low-contrast samples; (2) temple-blessings section now present on /temple. Verified via DOM testid query + visual screenshot. No remaining functional issues.
